paper.title_en: Double Yangians and quantum vertex algebras, I
paper.abstract_en: For any symmetrizable generalized Cartan matrix A, we introduce an algebra $\widehat{\mathcal{D}\mathcal{Y}}(A)$, which is essentially the centrally extended double Yangian when A is of finite type, and we give a new field (current) presentation of $\widehat{\mathcal{D}\mathcal{Y}}(A)$. Among the main results, for any $\ell \in {\mathbb {C}}$ we construct a universal vacuum $\widehat{\mathcal{D}\mathcal{Y}}(A)$-module $\mathcal {V}_A(\ell )$ of level $\ell $, prove that there exists a natural $\hbar $-adic weak quantum vertex algebra structure on $\mathcal {V}_A(\ell )$, and give an isomorphism between the category of restricted $\widehat{\mathcal{D}\mathcal{Y}}(A)$-modules of level $\ell $ and the category of $\mathcal {V}_A(\ell )$-modules.
